title: Deep Claim deployment diagram
description: How Deep Claim runs: one Cloudflare Worker with static assets and no database. The browser runs the whole game.

nodes.name: Player's browser
nodes.description: Runs the Godot engine (WebAssembly, WebGL 2) and the whole game; keeps the best haul in its own storage.

nodes.name: Cloudflare edge
nodes.description: Runs the Worker on icelander.net/games/retro/deep-claim*, ahead of the games hub's less specific route icelander.net/games/*.

nodes.name: deep-claim Worker
nodes.description: worker/index.ts: the signed-in game page and the joined engine file; every other path is a static asset from ./dist.

nodes.name: icelander.net login service
nodes.description: accounts.icelander.net, in the icelander.net repository (accounts/): who holds the host's site_session cookie and their games: roles. The Worker reaches it only through a service binding.

artifacts.name: Godot web export
artifacts.description: index.html, index.js, index.pck and the engine split into index.wasm.0 and index.wasm.1, served as static assets.

artifacts.name: Page files
artifacts.description: boot.js, shell.css, favicon.svg and _headers (a strict Content-Security-Policy), copied into dist/.

artifacts.name: Worker script
artifacts.description: The fetch handler, bundled by wrangler with vendor/icelander-auth.

relationships.description: HTTPS: the page, its assets and the engine.
Service binding ACCOUNTS (entrypoint Internal): the game's page needs a signed-in player.
